statement.text:
What concordance information about a knot $K$ is contained in
its 0-trace $X_{0}(K)$ and in its 0-surgery $S^{3}_{0}(K)$?
Specifically,
(a) Suppose $K$ and $K'$ have homeomorphic 0-traces.
(i) Are $K$ and $K'$ topologically concordant?
(ii) What if one just assumes $K$ and $K'$ have homeomorphic 0-surgeries?
(iii) What if one just assumes $K$ and $K'$ have 0-surgeries that are topolog-
ically homology cobordant, preserving the homology class of a merid-
ian.

(b) Suppose $K$ and $K'$ have homeomorphic 0-surgeries, where the image of
the meridian of $K$ is freely homotopic to the meridian of $K'$. Are $K$ and
$K'$ smoothly concordant?
